entity.name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS)

lineage.description: Tropical cyclone track data compiled by NOAA IBTrACS from direct observational sources (satellite, aircraft reconnaissance, surface stations) spanning 1980 to May 2019. Data represents best-track estimates of cyclone positions and intensities integrated from multiple international meteorological agencies and archived in shapefile format for spatial analysis.

sources.name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS)
sources.description: NOAA observational archive of global tropical cyclone tracks with best-track positions, intensities, and meteorological parameters derived from multiple observational sources including satellite, aircraft, and surface observations.
